 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Bayern Munich are hoping to return to winning ways in the Champions League as they face Atlético Madrid.
 The Bavarians have drawn their last two European fixtures against Viking FK and Arsenal, leaving them with five points from their opening three matches, while assistant coach Aaron Danks will once again take charge in the absence of Vincent Kompany.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Meanwhile, Diego Simeone's Atlético side are enjoying an impressive run of domestic form, sitting second in La Liga following Saturday's 2-0 victory over Levante, although they have collected just four points in the Champions League so far.
 With kick-off scheduled for 21:00 CET at the Metropolitano, both coaches are set to announce their starting lineups, which you can find below.
 Confirmed Atlético Madrid vs. Bayern Munich lineups:
 Atlético Madrid: Oblak - Pubill, Romero, Hancko, Grimaldo - Simeone, Llorente, Barrios, Baena - Alvarez, Sorloth
 Bayern Munich: Neuer - Laimer, Upamecano, Tah, Stanisic - Kimmich, Bischof - Karl, Oluse, Davies - Kane
